threat_event: Card numbers are stolen from the legacy PMS at 14 acquired hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy on-premises PMS displays and stores full card numbers; local accounts
regulatory_driver: N72-R01 (PCI DSS v4.0.1 Req. 3.4; 3.5); State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
existing_controls: Network firewalls; EDR on front office PCs
treatment_plan: Migrate the 14 hotels to the cloud PMS with tokenization; mask card numbers now

threat_event: Failed segmentation lets attackers move from guest or office networks into the CDE
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Segmentation tests failed at 6 hotels in 2025
treatment_plan: Fix rules; retest; semiannual segmentation tests

threat_event: The cloud PMS or reservation vendor has an outage or ransomware event
treatment_plan: Downtime drills each quarter; vendor exit plan

threat_event: A BAACS incident stops HVAC and ventilation at hotels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Hotel sites less segmented (19 of 88); no manual procedures at most hotels
treatment_plan: Segment hotel OT; manual procedures per hotel (group plan GR-01)

threat_event: The guest room lock encoding server is compromised to make unauthorized keys
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Encoding servers at 31 hotels run an unsupported operating system
existing_controls: Encoding server on the back-office network
treatment_plan: Upgrade encoding servers with the lock vendor

threat_event: Loyalty accounts are taken over and points stolen
Malicious script on a booking page skims card data before the payment page
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script inventory incomplete on 3 brand websites
treatment_plan: Script inventory and change detection on all booking pages

threat_event: Guest Wi-Fi is bridged to staff networks at older hotels
treatment_plan: Separate guest network hardware at renovation
owner: Hotels division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A POS or PMS support vendor's remote access is used to enter hotel networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor tools at 22 hotels outside group PAM
treatment_plan: Route vendor access through group PAM with MFA and recording

threat_event: Dynamic prices or chatbot answers show room rates without mandatory fees
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pricing engine and chatbot quote base rates in some channels
treatment_plan: Total price in every channel; monthly sample review

threat_event: Guest ID scans and old registers are kept longer than needed and breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: ID scans kept indefinitely at 40 hotels
treatment_plan: Retention: register 2 years (Florida worked example); ID scans 30 days after checkout

threat_event: The hourly hiring screening tool screens out applicants unfairly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor tool ranks about 31,000 applicants a year; no adverse impact analysis; California ADMT rules apply from 2027-01-01
treatment_plan: Adverse impact testing; human review of every rejection; notices (P10)

threat_event: The guest messaging assistant gives wrong safety or fee information or reveals another guest's data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Generative assistant with access to reservation data
existing_controls: Escalation to staff for safety topics
treatment_plan: Guardrail testing; no access to other guests' records; human handoff

threat_event: A front desk agent is talked into issuing a room key to the wrong person
treatment_plan: ID check enforced in the PMS before key encoding

threat_event: A skimmer is placed on an outlet POS device
owner: Hotels division security and compliance lead

threat_event: A hurricane closes coastal hotels and damages building systems
